doc.title: Cal Collins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 11, 1997

title: Introduction and growing up in the Cincinnati tri-state area
summary: Monk Rowe opens the interview; Collins says he was raised near Cincinnati, living in Indiana.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are interviewing today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. It’s a great pleasure to have Cal Collins, guitarist, with me today.
Welcome. You’re from the midwest originally.
Mideast we like to call it.
Okay. Not quite into the west.
Yeah, I was born and raised and live around what they call the tri-state area of Cincinnati, but we live in Indiana, which is just across the border. Kentucky is across the border, south.
